rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken noun for a social friend, and it can also be used loosely for someone known through others.

example.jyutping: nei5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this for an acquaintance, when the person is known but not really a friend.

example.english: That acquaintance is a friend of my cousin.
example.traditional: 嗰個熟人係我表哥嘅朋友。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 suk6 jan4 hai6 ngo5 biu2 go1 ge3 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this for a friend who is a helpful associate, rather than for an ordinary social friend.

example.english: He is a friend who helps out at our company.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for someone who backs a cause, idea, person, or position.

example.english: He is a friend of the environmental movement.
example.traditional: 佢係呢個環保運動嘅支持者。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 waan4 bou2 wan6 dung6 ge3 zi1 ci4 ze2
